events.description: A large crowd engages in violent unrest: individuals are seen throwing objects, clashing with others, and scattering debris across the ground; signs like 'WE WILL NOT' and 'WAT OP' suggest protest context, but the behavior escalates into collective violence including physical confrontations and projectile use.

Multiple pairs of individuals engage in mutual physical combat: visible grappling, punching, and kicking occur across frames, especially in central and left areas; participants are actively resisting each other, satisfying the definition of fighting.

At least one individual is seen lying on the ground while others stand over or strike them; in frames f6–f11, a person remains prone amid ongoing chaos while nearby figures appear to kick or stomp, indicating attack on a helpless victim.

Large-scale violent group clash between two factions (green-highlighted and blue/purple-highlighted units) in an open area, involving sustained melee combat, crowd surges, and use of explosive-like effects (e.g., firecrackers at t=26.5). The conflict intensifies over time with increasing density and chaotic movement.

Widespread mutual physical combat among numerous individuals; visible close-quarters grappling, swinging motions, and clustered engagements across the central area. Distinct from riot only in granularity—this captures the individual-level melee actions within the larger riot.

A bright, localized flash with radial particle burst and temporary illumination spike at center-right of crowd, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., firecracker), as confirmed by UI tooltip 'FIRECRACKERS' appearing at f5 (26.5s).

Large group of individuals engaged in violent, chaotic clashes in an open area; multiple colored particle effects (indicating gunfire, explosions, or special abilities) and smoke are visible throughout the sequence, with participants moving aggressively and densely packed in conflict zones.

Repeated bright muzzle-flash-like particle bursts (green, blue, red, white) emanating from multiple figures in the crowd, consistent with projectile weapons firing in a tactical simulation; sustained over time across frames.

A large group of people engaged in violent unrest, with individuals throwing objects, running chaotically, and clashing; debris is scattered across the ground, and banners are present, indicating a protest that has escalated into collective violence.
Multiple pairs of individuals are seen in close physical combat—grappling, striking, and falling—particularly in the central area of the scene during the initial phase of the unrest.
At least one individual appears to be on the ground while others surround and strike them; the victim shows no capacity to resist, consistent with targeted assault on a helpless person.

Large-scale violent unrest involving multiple groups of individuals clashing, throwing objects, and moving aggressively across an open area; debris is scattered widely, and participants exhibit coordinated hostile behavior consistent with a riot.

Multiple pairs and small clusters of individuals engaged in mutual physical combat (grappling, punching, kicking) visible in the central area; actions are reciprocal and sustained over several frames.
In frame f7–f8, one individual appears to be on the ground while another stands over them delivering repeated strikes; the posture and lack of resistance suggest a helpless victim being attacked.

Large-scale violent unrest involving two opposing groups: a dense crowd of civilians (many with red/green highlights, some holding signs or weapons) on the left and a formation of uniformed personnel (blue/green highlighted, possibly riot police or soldiers) on the right, separated by a barrier. The crowd surges forward repeatedly, projectiles appear mid-air (e.g., frame f4), and there is visible physical confrontation near the barrier (e.g., frames f0–f3 show individuals in close combat stances; frames f4–f15 show sustained clash with green particle effects indicating impacts or stun effects). A mission objective 'GET INSIDE THE CONSTRUCTION CAMP' appears at 210.5s, confirming hostile intent.

Close-quarters mutual physical combat between multiple individuals near the central barrier, visible as overlapping figures in aggressive postures with contact implied (e.g., frame f0 shows two figures grappling; f1–f3 show clusters of 3–4 people engaged in hand-to-hand struggle, with motion blur and proximity consistent with fighting).

Visual evidence of gunfire: bright muzzle flashes and projectile trails (white/blue streaks) emanating from the blue-uniformed group toward the civilian crowd, especially visible in frames f4–f6 and persisting through f15. Particle effects (green/white bursts) at impact points suggest ballistic impacts. The UI shows weapon icons (e.g., 'FIRECRACKERS' at f15), but the visual streaks and flashes are consistent with firearms discharge in this game context.
